notes: Fixes to catalog/press_domains.tsv (GDELT's 2018 domain table) for the press-tone layer (pipeline/press.py). A domain maps to a FIPS country code, or to null: counted as an unknown outlet, never assigned.
State media abroad keep their sponsoring state, as the 2018 table does for sputniknews.com and rt.com: RT and Sputnik regional sites are Russia, Press TV's UK site is Iran.
Checks behind each group: docs/relations/2026-11-15-press-outlets.md (13 Nov 2026 full day; 6-12 Nov 2026 one file an hour; translation-stream outlets coded US on 13 Nov 2026).
drop_location_names_why: GDELT geocodes the Spanish word 'Suede' (as in ordinary local news) to Sweden: about 1,350 of 2,100 articles mainly about Sweden on 13 Nov 2026 came from Spanish-language outlets, and 'Suede' was also the most common Sweden place name (320 mentions) in the 242 articles by US-coded outlets mainly about Sweden, 6-12 Nov 2026 (one file an hour), most of them Latin American outlets the 2018 table codes US. Real Spanish coverage names 'Suecia'.

overrides_why.aljazeera: The 2018 table puts aljazeera.com in the US and aljazeera.net in Israel; Al Jazeera is Qatari (Qatar showed about 1.4 articles a day before this fix).
overrides_why.storm.mg: Storm Media, Taiwanese, on Madagascar's .mg: all 86 'Madagascar' articles about Taiwan on 13 Nov 2026.
overrides_why.kcna.co.jp: The Korean Central News Agency's Japan-hosted site: North Korea's state agency.
overrides_why.nknews.org, kcnawatch.org: Specialist North Korea outlets (Korea Risk Group); left unassigned so they do not read as South Korean or US press.
overrides_why.euronews.com: European broadcaster (Lyon and Brussels newsrooms, many languages); coded US in the 2018 table; left unassigned.
overrides_why.motorward.com: Arabic car site coded US; the largest US-coded translation-stream domain on 13 Nov 2026 (450 articles); left unassigned.
overrides_why.Latin America: Costa Rican, Dominican, Puerto Rican (FIPS RQ), Peruvian, Venezuelan, Salvadoran and Ecuadorian outlets coded US in the 2018 table (13 Nov 2026 translation stream).
overrides_why.unknowns: The largest outlets with no country in the 2018 table, 6-12 Nov 2026 sample (unn.ua, dnews.gr, ici.fr, inews24.com and others); unclear ones were left out.
